records.jp: 千紘、最近どう？
records.en_original: How you doing lately, Chihiro?
records.en_auxiliary: How're you, Chihiro?
records.en: How have you been lately, Chihiro?

records.jp: 日菜子さん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-san...

records.jp: 何か本読んだ？
records.en_original: Did you read any books?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you read any books?
records.en: Did you read any books?

records.jp: それで、どうだった？<CR>何か積極的になるきっかけみたいなものは得られた？
records.en_original: So, how did it go? Did you find any ways to become more assertive?
records.en_auxiliary: So, how did it go? Did you find any ways to become more assertive?
records.en: So, how did it go?<CR>Did you find anything that might help you become more assertive?

records.jp: それが……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: そっかー。あんまり上手くいかなかったみたいね
records.en_original: Oof. Doesn't sound like it went so well.
records.en_auxiliary: Oof. Doesn't sound like it went so well.
records.en: I see... It doesn't sound like it went very well.

records.jp: ごめん……なさい……。<CR>アドバイス……してもらったのに……
records.en_original: I'm...sorry... And you took the time...to give me advice...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry... And you took the time... to give me advice.
records.en: I'm...sorry...<CR>Even after you...gave me advice...

records.jp: ううん、気にしないで
records.en_original: Don't worry about that.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about that.
records.en: Don't worry about that.

records.jp: （それより、どうすれば積極的になれるかな……。<CR>何が千紘を消極的にさせているんだろう……）
records.en_original: (More importantly, how can she become more assertive... Something must be holding Chihiro back...)
records.en_auxiliary: (More importantly, how can she become more assertive. Something must be holding Chihiro back.)
records.en: (More importantly, how can she become more assertive...?<CR>What's making Chihiro so withdrawn...?)

records.jp: （うーん……。<CR>そうだ！　きっと千紘には自信が足りないんだ）
records.en_original: (Hmm... Oh I know! Chihiro must lack self confidence.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hmm... Oh I know! Chihiro must lack self-confidence.)
records.en: (Hmm...<CR>That's it! Chihiro must lack confidence.)

records.jp: （自信がないから積極的になろうとしても<CR>上手くいかないんだ）
records.en_original: (Even if you want to be more assertive, it doesn't work without confidence.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Even if you want to be more assertive, it doesn't work without confidence.)
records.en: (Without confidence, even if she tries to be assertive,<CR>it won't go well.)

records.jp: （それなら、まずは千紘に自信を持ってもらうのが大事かも……）
records.en_original: (So maybe the first thing Chihiro should do is build her confidence...)
records.en_auxiliary: (So maybe the first thing Chihiro should do is build that up.)
records.en: (Maybe helping Chihiro gain confidence should come first...)

records.jp: ねえ千紘。私思うんだけど千紘が積極的になれないのは<CR>自信がないからだと思う
records.en_original: Hey, Chihiro? I'm just thinking, but maybe you can't be any more assertive because you lack confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Chihiro? I'm just thinking, but maybe you can't be any more assertive because you need more confidence.
records.en: You know, Chihiro. I think the reason you can't be assertive<CR>is that you lack confidence.

records.jp: だから、まずは自分の得意なことでクラスや学校に貢献して<CR>自信をつけたらどうかな？
records.en_original: So, to build confidence, you should contribute to your class or school in ways that you're good at.
records.en_auxiliary: To improve, you should contribute to your class or school in ways that you're good at.
records.en: So why not build some confidence by using what you're good at<CR>to contribute to the class or school?

records.jp: 何かアイデアない？
records.en_original: Have any ideas?
records.en_auxiliary: Have any ideas?
records.en: Have any ideas?

records.jp: え、えーと……。<CR>作った……ぬいぐるみを……教室に……おいて……
records.en_original: U-um... I...use the stuffed toys I make...to decorate the classroom...
records.en_auxiliary: U-um... I use the stuffed toys I make...to decorate the classroom.
records.en: U-um...<CR>I could put...the plushies I make...in the classroom...

records.jp: そっか、千紘は教室にぬいぐるみを飾って<CR>クラスの雰囲気をなごませたいんだね……
records.en_original: I see, I guess your plushies could give the class a softer atmosphere...
records.en_auxiliary: I see, I guess your plushies could give the classroom a softer atmosphere.
records.en: I see. You want to decorate the classroom with plushies<CR>and make it feel more welcoming...

records.jp: うん。いいと思う。クラスメートに目に見える形で<CR>貢献できると思うし……
records.en_original: Yeah, I think that's good. And it would contribute in a way that your classmates can really see...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I think that's good. And it would contribute in a way that your classmates can really see.
records.en: Yeah, I think that's a good idea. You'd be contributing<CR>in a way your classmates can actually see...

records.jp: もう……飾ってるの……
records.en_original: I...already decorate it...
records.en_auxiliary: I... already decorate it.
records.en: I...already have them on display...

records.jp: え、あのぬいぐるみ千紘が作ったの？
records.en_original: Wait, you made that stuffed toy?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, you made that stuffed toy?
records.en: Wait, you made that plushie?

records.jp: う……うん
records.en_original: Y-yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yes.
records.en: Y-yes...

records.jp: （やっぱり、千紘の作風って変わってる……）
records.en_original: (I knew it was unique, in a Chihiro sort of way...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I knew it was unique in a Chihiro sort of way.)
records.en: (I knew it... Chihiro's style really is unusual...)

records.jp: へぇ、やっぱり独創的ね……
records.en_original: Huh, a true original...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, a true original.
records.en: Wow... It certainly is original...

records.jp: それで、クラスの評判はどうだったの？
records.en_original: So what did the class think about it?
records.en_auxiliary: So what did the class think about it?
records.en: So what did the class think about it?

records.jp: あんまり……反応……ない……
records.en_original: They...didn't respond much...
records.en_auxiliary: They... didn't respond much.
records.en: They...didn't respond much...

records.jp: そ、そう……。<CR>うーん……。それじゃあ、ほかに得意なことはないの？
records.en_original: I-I see... Hmm... Then are you good at anything else?
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see. Hmm... Then are you good at anything else?
records.en: I-I see...<CR>Hmm... Then is there anything else you're good at?

records.jp: えーと……
records.en_original: Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: お花……！<CR>わたし……お花のお世話なら……できる
records.en_original: Flowers...! I can... Take care of flowers...
records.en_auxiliary: Flowers! I can take care of flowers.
records.en: Flowers...!<CR>I can...take care of flowers...

records.jp: そうなんだ
records.en_original: Interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: That could be good.
records.en: I see.

records.jp: じゃあさ。私と学校の花壇のお手入れしない？
records.en_original: Then how about you and I work on the school flowerbed?
records.en_auxiliary: How about you and I work on the school flowerbed?
records.en: Then why don't we take care of the school flowerbeds together?

records.jp: ほら、千紘の得意分野だし、自分できれいにした花壇を<CR>他の人に見てもらったら自信つくんじゃないかな
records.en_original: It's something you're good at, and I'm sure you'd gain confidence if others saw you make a flowerbed beautiful.
records.en_auxiliary: It's something you're good at, and I'm sure you'd gain confidence if others saw you make a flowerbed beautiful.
records.en: It's something you're good at, and if other people see<CR>the flowerbeds you've made beautiful, I bet you'll gain confidence.

records.jp: ……うん！　やって……みる
records.en_original: ...Okay! I'll...try it.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! I'll... try it.
records.en: ...Okay! I'll...try it.

records.jp: それじゃあ、決まり！<CR>また、その時になったら教えてよ
records.en_original: Then it's settled! Let me know when you want to get started.
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's settled! Let me know when you want to get started.
records.en: Then it's settled!<CR>Let me know when you're ready.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……ありがとう……
records.en_original: Hinako... Thank you...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako... Thank you.
records.en: Hinako-san... Thank you...

records.jp: あのぬいぐるみやっぱり千紘の作品だったんだ！
records.en_original: So that stuffed toy really was your work!
records.en_auxiliary: So that stuffed toy really was your work!
records.en: So that plushie really was your work!

records.jp: 作風が千紘っぽかったし、そうじゃないかなって……
records.en_original: It seemed very "Chihiro" to me, so I figured...
records.en_auxiliary: It seemed very "Chihiro" to me, so I figured...
records.en: It seemed very "Chihiro" to me, so I figured...

records.jp: あり……がとう……。覚えてて……くれて
records.en_original: Thank...you... For remembering...
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you... For remembering.
records.en: Thank...you...for remembering.

records.jp: うん。<CR>それで、クラスメートから何か反応はあったの？
records.en_original: Sure. So, how did your classmates respond?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. So how did your classmates respond?
records.en: Yeah.<CR>So, did your classmates say anything about them?

records.jp: そう……。<CR>それじゃ。他に何か得意なことってない？
records.en_original: I see... So, are you good at anything else?
records.en_auxiliary: I see... So, are you good at anything else?
records.en: I see...<CR>Then is there anything else you're good at?

records.jp: うぅ……。<CR>お花……。わたし……お花の……お世話なら……
records.en_original: Um... Flowers... I can... Take care of flowers...
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Flowers. I can... take care of flowers.
records.en: U-um...<CR>Flowers... I can...take care of flowers...

records.jp: そっか。千紘はお花の世話ができるんだね
records.en_original: Interesting. I don't know if I would've expected that.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. I don't know if I would've expected that.
records.en: I see. So you're good at taking care of flowers.

records.jp: （お花の世話かぁ……。<CR>どうやって自信持ってもらおう……）
records.en_original: (Growing flowers, huh... How can I help her gain confidence with flowers?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Growing flowers... How can I help her gain confidence through flowers?)
records.en: (Taking care of flowers, huh...?<CR>How can I use that to help her gain confidence...?)

records.jp: うーん……。そうだ！　千紘！<CR>一緒に学校の花壇のお手入れしてみない？
records.en_original: Hmm... I know! Chihiro, want to work on the school flowerbed together?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I know! Chihiro, want to work on the school flowerbed together?
records.en: Hmm... That's it! Chihiro!<CR>Why don't we take care of the school flowerbeds together?

records.jp: 目に見える形で学校に貢献できるし、<CR>生徒たちにも見てもらえるから自信になると思うな
records.en_original: You can contribute to the school in a visible way, and I think you'd gain confidence when the students see it.
records.en_auxiliary: You can contribute to the school in a visible way, and I think you'd gain confidence when everyone sees how great it is!
records.en: You'd be contributing to the school in a visible way,<CR>and having the students see it should give you confidence.

records.jp: うん……！<CR>やってみる……
records.en_original: Okay...! I'll try it...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! I'll try it.
records.en: Okay...!<CR>I'll try it...

records.jp: 日菜子……さん。<CR>いろいろ……あり……がとう
records.en_original: Hinako... Thank you...for everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako... Thank you... for everything.
records.en: Hinako...san.<CR>Thank you...for everything.
